settings.heading: What makes The Fleece Leggings unique?
settings.content:
A Comfort Made for Winter’s Embrace

As the air turns crisp, The Fleece Leggings become more than just a layer, they are a shield of warmth and ease. From golden autumn walks to frosty winter evenings, they offer the perfect balance of softness, stretch, and effortless style.

Versatile and refined, they pair as naturally with a cozy sweater as with an elegant coat, moving with you like a gentle embrace never heavy, always warm.

Why Are The Fleece Leggings Essential?

  • Designed for autumn strolls and winter nights indoors
  • A sleek fit with gentle stretch that adapts to your body
  • Warmth without weight, comfort without compromise
  • Effortless pairing with seasonal layers

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Machine wash cold, tumble dry on low heat, and avoid ironing or using fabric softeners to maintain the softness and coziness of your clothes for years to come.

settings.heading: Do they run true to size?
settings.row_content:
They generally run true to size, but the fleece lining makes them slightly more snug than regular tights.

We recommend sizing up if you’re between sizes. Check out our size guide above.

settings.heading: Are these tall girl friendly?
settings.row_content: Yes, we made it our goal to be inclusive to every body no matter the shape, size, or height.

settings.heading: How do I find my perfect color match?
settings.row_content:
• Vanilla (Light) – Fair to light skin tones

• Tan – Light to medium skin tones

• Bronze – Medium to deep skin tones

• Deep – Deep to rich skin tones

Check our shade guide photos above, or message us for help! 95% of our customers say the color match is perfect.

settings.heading: What if I order the wrong shade?
settings.row_content: No worries! We offer a 100-Day Size & Shade Match Guarantee. If the color isn’t quite right, you can exchange it hassle-free.

settings.heading: Do the colors look natural or obviously fake?
settings.row_content: They look incredibly natural! Customers consistently rave that people think they’re wearing regular sheer tights or even bare legs. The colors are designed to blend seamlessly with your skin tone.

settings.heading: Can I wear them outside in winter?
settings.row_content: Yes! The fleece lining keeps you surprisingly warm without overheating. Customers have worn these in NYC winters, with jean shorts in windy weather, and for all-day outdoor events. They’re warm but breathable – perfect for fall through winter.

settings.heading: Are they comfortable for all-day wear?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! They’re soft, stretchy, and feel more like leggings than traditional tights. Many professionals (including flight attendants!) wear them for 8+ hour shifts.

settings.heading: Do they itch or feel scratchy?
settings.row_content: Not at all. The interior fleece is soft and cozy - Customers describe them as feeling like “buttah” or a warm hug.

settings.heading: Will these rip or run easily?
settings.row_content:
These are made with premium-thickness material (38.9% Nylon, 14.9% Spandex, 46.2% Polyester) and feel more like pants than traditional pantyhose. To maximize durability and prevent pilling:

• Always flip inside out before washing

• Hand wash or use gentle cycle

• Hang dry or use lowest heat

• Avoid hot water

• Be gentle when pulling them on

settings.heading: Do they have a crotch seam or one-seam design?
settings.row_content: We offer a one-seam design option that eliminates the center back seam for a smooth, seamless silhouette with no bunching or bulk. No “diaper butt” situation here!

settings.heading: How should I wash these?
settings.row_content:
🧺 Flip inside out before washing

🫧 Hand wash or gentle cycle only

❄️ Cold/warm water (never hot!)

🌞 Hang dry or lowest heat tumble dry

settings.heading: Can I put them in the dryer?
settings.row_content: You can use the lowest heat setting, but hang drying is recommended to extend their life. High heat can damage the elastic fibers.
